title: Chaturanga tutorial for complete beginners / Yoga 101 Pose Tutorial
description:
📲 Would you like to practice with me daily and access all of my exclusive classes? Download the BringMeYoga App and start your 14-day FREE trial http://onelink.to/bringmeyoga

I struggled with this pose for so long! Chaturanga was one of the poses I actually avoided🤫

It felt so uncomfortable that I’d just skip it, which is actually fine btw 😛 but this year I decided to get better at it and by practicing and falling on my chest (A LOT) I got more comfortable at it.

It takes a lot of practice so don’t get discouraged! Actually if I still try to do it more than 4-5 times a row I start feeling wobbly. This pose is INTENSE!

So keep practicing, put these tips into work and lower down on your knees whenever you need to 😙😚
